text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp is starting. They 
taught us in class that summer is a time 
where Umamusume can grow by leaps and 
bounds!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my very best for the Sprinters 
Stakes too! Of course, I'll be keeping a 
close eye on you as well, Sky-san!
